sparrows.line: The ravens and the crows, robins and the sparrows
stanza: The pine trees are narrow, a billion broken arrows
The ravens and the crows, robins and the sparrows
All across Ontario, static on the stereo
Went swimming in the lake, Old Woman Bay

sparrows.line: I thought of Saint Francis and his sparrows
sparrows.linePrev: And I turned my gun on the bird-like Mr. Brookes
sparrows.lineNext: And as I shot down the youthful Richardson
